claims.text: Coinbase opened access to 170+ derivatives contracts (perpetuals up to 50x leverage, dated futures up to 20x, crypto options) for UK professional investors starting 2026-08-11, per a company blog post by UK head Keith Grose, following its MiFID license.
claims.note: 1차 URL(coinbase.com, 저자 Keith Grose)은 검색 결과로 식별했으나 WebFetch 직접 접근 403 차단. The Block(등급3, 2026-08-11) 등 복수 2차 매체가 동일 사실(계약 수·레버리지·MiFID 근거) 교차확인. 직접 열람 실패로 confirmed=false 유지(보수적).

claims.text: Coinbase obtained a Financial Services Permission (FSP) from Abu Dhabi Global Market's Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA), announced 2026-08-13, enabling it to establish an international tokenization hub covering deal arrangement, custody, and issuance/registration of tokenized securities (fully backed by underlying shares, with shareholder rights incl. dividends/voting). Release also references a parallel derivatives trading hub initiative in Dubai.
claims.note: prnewswire.com 원문 직접 열람 성공(grade 1). Dubai 파생상품 허브 언급은 후속 확인 필요 — 별도 unconfirmed 없음, 본 릴리스 부기 사항.

claims.text: Coinbase CFO Alesia Haas stated on the Q2 2026 earnings call (2026-07-30): "We have already met the conditions for the Circle contract to renew, so it will renew on the same terms." The Coinbase-Circle USDC revenue-sharing Collaboration Agreement (effective since 2023-08-18) is set to auto-renew for another 3-year term on 2026-08-18.
claims.note: 조회 기간(8/8 이후) 이전 발화(7/30)이나 usdc_economics 축의 핵심 미확정 리스크(Circle 계약 갱신 조건)를 직접 해소하는 경영진 원문 인용이라 포함. 갱신 발효일(8/18)은 아직 미도래 — 실제 갱신 완료 공시는 차기 조회 대상.

claims.text: The UK derivatives access expansion and Abu Dhabi tokenization hub broaden Coinbase's regulated product surface geographically, but neither disclosure includes incremental revenue figures; near-term (Q3 2026) financial contribution is likely immaterial relative to core subscription/trading revenue pending company disclosure.
claims.note: 거래 매출과 구독 매출 합산 서술 금지 규칙 준수 — 신규 사업 매출 기여를 추정치로 서술하지 않음, '미확정'으로만 표기.
